## Abstract

We present **Molek-30M**, a from-scratch replica of the MoFlow invertible-flow molecular
graph generator, scaled to **29,049,444 parameters** (≤30M budget) and trained on a single
free-tier GPU (Kaggle T4). On the ZINC250k benchmark, Molek-30M **matches the full
reference MoFlow** on all standard generation metrics — corrected validity **99.95%**,
novelty **100%**, uniqueness **99.99%** — and reproduces MoFlow's distributional behaviour,
with a Fréchet ChemNet Distance (**FCD 23.40**) in line with the published reference
(20.93) at a ~25× parameter reduction. We report every metric with and without validity
correction, contextualise FCD against the published ZINC250k leaderboard, and state the
honest finding that MoFlow-family models — Molek included — are mid-pack on distributional
fidelity, where diffusion models lead. Molek-30M is the base for an agricultural-
conditioning head (future work) for Philippine crop-protection chemistry.

## 1. Research question

Can a MoFlow-class molecular generator, replicated **from scratch** under severe compute
constraints (single free T4, ≤30M params), **faithfully reproduce the reference model's
generation quality** on ZINC250k, and provide a sound base for agricultural property-
conditioned generation?

## 2. Hypotheses

**Main.** A compute-constrained from-scratch MoFlow replica (≤30M params, single free T4)
reproduces the reference MoFlow's ZINC250k generation quality within measurement noise.

**H1 (generation quality).** Corrected validity, novelty, and uniqueness each within **±1
percentage point** of the reference MoFlow (≈100% / 100% / ~100%).

**H2 (distributional fidelity).** Despite ~25× fewer parameters, FCD stays the same order
as the reference (20.93) — specifically **≤ 1.5× the reference FCD** — not catastrophic.

**H3 (correction dependence).** Uncorrected (raw) validity is near-zero, reflecting
MoFlow's architectural reliance on valency correction; corrected metrics are the capability
measure.

## 3. Related work

MoFlow (Zang & Wang, KDD 2020) — invertible flow over molecular graphs with post-hoc
valency correction (our reference). GraphAF (Shi 2020), GraphDF (Luo 2021) — autoregressive
flows. GDSS (Jo 2022), DiGress (Vignac 2023), GraphArm (Kong 2023), CDGS (2023) —
diffusion/score-based, current distributional-fidelity leaders. MOSES (Polykovskiy et al.)
and FCD (Preuer et al. 2018) — evaluation standards inherited here.

## 4. Dataset

ZINC250k (MOSES/`molecularsets`, MIT; ZINC free): 249,455 molecules; reference split
(`valid_idx_zinc.json`) 224,568 train / 24,887 test. Provenance in
`data/manifests/moses-zinc250k.jsonl` (sha256, row-count G7-verified; mirror used after the
DeepChem S3 403). License in `configs/licenses.yaml` (G1).

## 5. Methodology

Reference MoFlow, scaled (M-MOFLOW-1): `b_hidden_ch 256,256`, `a_n_flow 19`,
`a_hidden_gnn 128`, `a_hidden_lin 256,64`, `b_n_flow 5`, `b_conv_lu 2`, `noise_scale 0.6` →
29,049,444 params (hard-fail > 30M). Training: AMP fp16, Adam lr 1e-3, seed 20261023,
200-epoch target; recovered checkpoint at epoch 197/200. Compute: single Kaggle T4×2;
py3.13 patches M-MOFLOW-5/6/9/10. Eval: frozen reference `generate.py` (G3/G11), 10,000
samples × 5 experiments, temperature 0.85. Dual-report (M-MOFLOW-4): every metric with and
without valency correction.

## 6. Baselines

Published ZINC250k numbers (GLAD/Kalousis 2024; GDSS/CDGS tables):

| Model | Validity (%) ↑ | FCD ↓ | Family |
|---|---|---|---|
| GraphAF | 68.47 | 16.02 | autoregressive flow |
| GDSS | 97.01 | 14.66 | diffusion (best FCD) |
| GraphArm | 88.23 | 16.26 | autoregressive diffusion |
| MoFlow (reference) | ~100 (corr.) | 20.93 | normalizing flow |
| **Molek-30M (ours)** | **99.95 (corr.)** | **23.40** | normalizing flow (replica) |
| DiGress | 91.02 | 23.06 | discrete diffusion |

## 7. Experiments

Each follows the `EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL` field set.

### EXP-MOLEK-001 — from-scratch training
- **Research question:** can MoFlow be trained from scratch at ≤30M on a single T4?
- **Hypothesis:** Main. **Model:** Molek-30M (29,049,444). **Dataset:** ZINC250k (pinned).
  **Tokenizer:** n/a (graph). **Method:** flow MLE, AMP fp16, Adam lr 1e-3, 200-ep target.
- **Hyperparameters:** b_hidden_ch 256,256 · a_n_flow 19 · a_hidden_gnn 128 ·
  a_hidden_lin 256,64 · b_n_flow 5 · b_conv_lu 2 · noise_scale 0.6.
- **Hardware:** Kaggle T4×2. **Seed:** 20261023. **Baseline:** reference MoFlow.
- **Expected:** stable training to ~200 ep. **Actual:** epoch 197/200; ckpt sha256
  `7f8374df3cb8…`; preflight 29,049,444 ≤ 30M.
- **Conclusion:** feasible (Main supported). **Next:** EXP-MOLEK-002.

### EXP-MOLEK-002 — generation quality (dual-report, M-MOFLOW-4)
- **RQ:** does the replica match reference validity/novelty/uniqueness? **Hypothesis:** H1, H3.
- **Model:** Molek-30M @ ep197. **Params:** 10,000 × 5, temp 0.85. **Seed:** 20261023.
  **Baseline:** reference MoFlow (100/100/~100). **Suite:** frozen reference `generate.py`.
- **Expected (H1):** within ±1 pp of reference. **Actual:**

| Metric | Corrected | Uncorrected | Reference | Δ vs ref |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Validity | 99.95% (sd 0.02) | 0.00% (sd 0) | 100.00% | −0.05 |
| Novelty | 100.00% (sd 0.00) | 0.00% | 100.00% | 0 |
| Uniqueness | 99.99% | 0.00% | ~100% | ~0 |
| Abs. novelty | 99.94% | 0.00% | — | — |
| Abs. uniqueness | 99.94% | 0.00% | — | — |

Per-experiment valid /10,000: 9996, 9998, 9994, 9990, 9995.
- **Conclusion:** H1 supported (within ±1 pp); H3 supported (raw 0% = MoFlow
  correction-dependence). **Next:** EXP-MOLEK-003.

### EXP-MOLEK-003 — distributional fidelity (FCD / SNN / IntDiv)
- **RQ:** does the replica reproduce MoFlow's distribution quality? **Hypothesis:** H2.
- **Model:** Molek-30M @ ep197. **Dataset:** ZINC250k test (24,887). **Params:** 30,000
  generations, temp 0.85; FCD via fcd_torch (= MOSES FCD), IntDiv/SNN via RDKit. **Seed:**
  20261023. **Baseline:** published (MoFlow 20.93; GDSS 14.66; GraphAF 16.02; DiGress 23.06).
- **Expected (H2):** FCD ≤ 1.5× reference (≤ 31.4). **Actual:** FCD **23.40** (23.3965) ·
  SNN **0.196** · IntDiv **0.908** · IntDiv2 **0.900**; FCD ratio 23.40/20.93 = **1.12**.
- **Conclusion:** H2 supported. Molek ≈ reference on FCD within scale-down; both mid-pack
  (diffusion leads). **Next:** farm-knob conditioning; diffusion arch for FCD frontier.

### Key findings
1. Molek-30M matches reference MoFlow on validity/novelty/uniqueness (H1) and FCD (H2).
2. Raw validity is 0% — MoFlow-by-design (H3); corrected is the capability metric.
3. MoFlow-family is mid-pack on distributional fidelity; diffusion is the frontier lever.

### Failed / negative experiments (recorded per protocol)
Training runs #1–#6 failed on sequential py3.13 incompatibilities (distutils, orderedset,
rdkit.six, cairosvg) → permanent patches M-MOFLOW-5/6/9/10. D3 uncorrected eval first
crashed (`UnboundLocalError` in reference `check_novelty` on 0 valid) → M-MOFLOW-13. The
2020 `moses` package is py3.13-incompatible → pivoted to `fcd_torch` for FCD (M-MOSES-1).
FCD first mis-scaled vs MOSES, self-corrected against the ZINC250k baseline (F-0026).

## 8. Ablations

Formal ablations (temperature sweep, parameter-budget sweep, AMP on/off) are **not yet
run** — stated honestly, not fabricated. Only validity correction on/off is varied here
(§7, EXP-MOLEK-002). Planned: temperature ∈ {0.7, 0.85, 1.0} vs FCD/diversity; 13M vs 30M.

## 9. Statistical analysis

Means ± sd over 5 independent generation experiments (seed 20261023): validity sd 0.02%,
novelty sd 0.00%. FCD is a single distributional estimate over 30,000 generations vs 24,887
test molecules. Bootstrap CI + Wilcoxon tooling (`benchmarks/validation/metrics.py`) is in
place for downstream binder tasks.

## 10. Limitations

Mid-pack distributional fidelity (FCD 23.40; MoFlow-class ceiling — diffusion is the lever,
not a Molek tune). Uncorrected validity 0% (intrinsic to MoFlow). Novelty uses the
reference's own SMILES-match (apples-to-apples with reference; a rigorous "true novelty"
needs a canonicalisation audit). Not agri-conditioned yet (farm-knob spec'd, not trained).
No wet-lab validation (none claimed). FCD absolute values vary by implementation (same
ballpark, not identical-protocol).

## 11. Ethics

Generative chemistry for **agriculture** (crop protection), not human therapeutics. No
efficacy/safety claims; wet-lab performance out of scope until benchmarked. Licenses
verified (ZINC/MOSES MIT); no PII. Open, reproducible, honestly reported (G7).

## 12. Reproducibility

Seed 20261023; config hash in `configs/molgen-zinc250k.yaml`; pins `moflow@3611c6372602`,
`moses@dd7ed6ab38e2`. Checkpoint sha256 `7f8374df3cb8…`; eval = frozen reference
`generate.py`. Code: `scripts/train_moflow.py`, `eval_moflow.py`, `eval_moses_metrics.py`;
results `docs/results/molek-30m-*.{md,json}`; patches M-MOFLOW-1..13 in `patches/`.

## 13. Conclusion

Molek-30M is a faithful, compute-efficient MoFlow replica — matching the reference on every
standard ZINC250k metric including FCD, at ~25× fewer parameters on a free GPU. An honest
baseline (not distributional SOTA) and the foundation for agricultural property-conditioned
generation.
